parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

command.description: The command that is passed to the container

cpu.description: The number of cpu units reserved for the container

disableNetworking.description: When this parameter is true, networking is disabled within the container

dnsSearchDomains.description: A list of DNS search domains that are presented to the container

dnsServers.description: A list of DNS servers that are presented to the container

dockerLabels.description: A key/value map of labels to add to the container

dockerSecurityOptions.description: A list of strings to provide custom labels for SELinux and AppArmor multi-level security systems

environment.description: The environment variables to pass to a container

essential.description:
If the essential parameter of a container is marked as true, and that container fails or stops for any reason,
all other containers that are part of the task are stopped

extraHosts.description: A list of hostnames and IP address mappings to append to the /etc/hosts file on the container

hostname.description: The hostname to use for your container

image.description: The image used to start a container

links.description: The link parameter allows containers to communicate with each other without the need for port mappings

memory.description: The hard limit (in MiB) of memory to present to the container

memoryReservation.description: The soft limit (in MiB) of memory to reserve for the container

mountPoints.description: The mount points for data volumes in your container

portMappings.description: The list of port mappings for the container

privileged.description: When this parameter is true, the container is given elevated privileges on the host container instance

readonlyRootFilesystem.description: When this parameter is true, the container is given read-only access to its root file system

ulimit.description: A list of ulimits to set in the container

user.description: The user name to use inside the container

volumeFrom.description: Data volumes to mount from another container

workingDirectory.description: The working directory in which to run commands inside the container
